skyblock-shopping-list.command.credits: %s by Tad, based on Inventory Reader by Scholiboi
skyblock-shopping-list.command.help.hud: - /ssl hud: Move or resize the HUD
skyblock-shopping-list.command.help.menu: - /ssl menu: Open the menu (shopping list, resources, recipes, settings)
skyblock-shopping-list.command.help.rese: - /ssl reset: Reset this profile's tracked data and the HUD settings (saved lists and presets are kept)
skyblock-shopping-list.config.advanced.d: Write what the mod reads (sack messages, Forge and HOTM menus, recipe downloads) to latest.log, to help track down a problem. Warnings and errors are always logged.
skyblock-shopping-list.config.advanced.k: Rebind keys. This mod's keys are under "%s".
skyblock-shopping-list.config.appearance: Shows the HUD with the saved look in Move HUD. Press Save first to see changes there; the preview above already shows them.
Puts every Appearance setting back to the original look, right away (the Settings tab is kept). Your current look is kept as the preset "%s".
skyblock-shopping-list.config.decoration: Show ✔ or ✖ in front of each row.
Draw a background and coloured border behind each row.
Draw lines joining ingredients to their recipe.
skyblock-shopping-list.config.hud.enable: Show the shopping list on screen. Also toggled with H.
skyblock-shopping-list.config.hud.max_re: How many recipes the shopping list can hold.
skyblock-shopping-list.config.hud.move.d: Drag a panel to move it, a corner to scale it, an edge to resize it. Also opened with B.
skyblock-shopping-list.config.hud.reset_: Put the HUD back in the top-left corner.
skyblock-shopping-list.config.list.auto_: Take a recipe off the list once you have made the amount you asked for.
skyblock-shopping-list.config.list.deepe: Give items you hold or have cooking in the Forge to the step you make first (the deepest one in a recipe tree) instead of the first row that needs them.
skyblock-shopping-list.config.list.item_: With the SkyBlock Item List mod installed, show a ☰ button on its recipes that adds the item to your shopping list.
skyblock-shopping-list.config.notificati: When you have made the amount you asked for.
Off, Chat, Toast (a pop-up), or Both. Only while on SkyBlock.
When a recipe on your list can be crafted from what you have.
After joining, and when you add a recipe, raise its amount or load a saved list: the sacks you haven't opened yet that hold items the list needs, so its counts are right.
When your sacks haven't been opened for an hour, at most once an hour. Between opens, sack counts follow the [Sacks] chat summaries and can drift.
skyblock-shopping-list.config.panel_colo: Colours of the panels themselves: background, borders, titles, text and the Craftable / Forging sections.
Inside main panel: part of the shopping list panel.
Own panel: a separate panel you can move and resize on its own in Move HUD.
skyblock-shopping-list.config.presets.co: Copies the current look and panel sizes as text, to paste in chat or Discord.
skyblock-shopping-list.config.presets.de: Deletes the chosen preset. Built-in presets can't be deleted.
Presets hold the look plus each panel's size, scale and placement. Panel positions and the Settings tab are never changed.
skyblock-shopping-list.config.presets.lo: Switches to the chosen preset. Your current look is kept as "%s" first, so you can switch back.
skyblock-shopping-list.config.presets.na: Name used by Save current as preset.
skyblock-shopping-list.config.presets.pa: Reads a share code from the clipboard, saves it as a preset and switches to it. Your current look is kept as "%s" first.
skyblock-shopping-list.config.presets.pr: Your saved presets, then the built-in looks. "%s" is your look from before the last Load, Paste or Reset.
skyblock-shopping-list.config.presets.sa: Saves the current look and panel sizes under the name above (a number is added if the name is taken).
Press Save first if you have unsaved Appearance changes.
skyblock-shopping-list.config.rows.amoun:
Remaining: what is still left to get (3×).
Have / need: what you hold of what is needed (83/5,120).
Required: the full amount the recipes need (6×).

Colours: red = none yet, orange = some, yellow = can craft from what you have, blue = cooking in the Forge, green = done.
skyblock-shopping-list.config.rows.event:
Show a ! after rows you still need whose item only drops during a mayor's event, while you can farm it: shark drops in a Fishing Festival, Refined Mineral and Glossy Gemstone in a Mining Fiesta, Diana's mob drops in her Mythological Ritual. Foxy's Extra Event counts too. Hover the row in the List tab to see the event.
Event running: only while the event is on.
Perk active: all term, while the mayor or minister has the perk.
Off: no mark.
skyblock-shopping-list.config.rows.forge:
Shows how long the Forge still needs after a row's name, e.g. [25hrs]: every forge craft still to make for that row, one after another (time × how many, plus its ingredients). This is the worst case: forging several at once finishes sooner.
Items cooking now add the time they have left. Crafts not started yet get Quick Forge (open Heart of the Mountain once) and Cole's Molten Forge while he is mayor or minister. Long names are cut short so the time always shows.
skyblock-shopping-list.config.rows.hide_: Leave out ingredient rows you already have enough of (green), in the recipe trees and the Total. Recipe rows always show, and so do rows from a sack not read yet. The List tab still shows everything.
skyblock-shopping-list.config.rows.progr:
Fills each recipe row's background with how far along it is, counted in the raw materials under it: 21/80 Fine Ruby under 0/1 Flawless Ruby fills both rows 26%%. What you already hold counts as done. The bar takes the row's colour.
Top level: the recipe rows. Down to 1st level: also the ingredients they take directly.
skyblock-shopping-list.config.rows.recip: Show a padlock after rows you still need to make whose recipe has to be unlocked first (a collection, HotM or slayer level), or that has such a row further down. Hover the row in the List tab to see what it requires. Your own unlocks aren't read, so it shows even when you have them.
skyblock-shopping-list.config.rows.short: Show big amounts as 5.1k, 512k, 500m or 1.5b instead of the full number (rounded down).
skyblock-shopping-list.config.rows.total: The same progress bars for the Total section: the Total row on top level, and each material in it from 1st level on.
skyblock-shopping-list.config.sections.c: Show what you can craft right now.
skyblock-shopping-list.config.sections.f:
What is cooking in your Forge, read when you open it.
All: every forge slot; items the list doesn't need use the "Forging text (not on list)" colour (red by default).
Listed: only items the list needs.
Off: no Forging section.
skyblock-shopping-list.config.sections.k:
Kills left until the drop.
Best: lucky with your Magic Find (a quarter of players have it by then).
You: the average with your Magic Find.
Worst: the average with no Magic Find.
All: the three together.
skyblock-shopping-list.config.sections.m: Your Magic Find for the estimates. 0 reads it from the tab list (Stats widget) or the last RARE DROP message.
For items on the list that drop from mobs: kills since the last drop and about how many more it takes. Every combat kill counts, whatever the mob.
skyblock-shopping-list.config.sections.n: Show at the bottom what every raw material on the list costs to buy from NPCs, and what NPCs pay for it. Only coin prices; items no NPC sells or buys are left out (the item count shows how many have a price).
skyblock-shopping-list.config.sections.r: Start every Mob drops kill count from 0.
skyblock-shopping-list.config.sections.t: Show a Total at the top of the HUD with every raw material still needed across all recipes.

Raw materials: everything down to the basic items (e.g. Titanium).
Level 1: the pieces each recipe on your list takes directly (e.g. Drill Motor, Refined Titanium).
Level 2: what those take, and so on. Raw materials needed above that level are listed as they are.
skyblock-shopping-list.config.size.hud_s: Size of every HUD panel, in percent. 100%% is the original size.
skyblock-shopping-list.config.size.sizin:
Window size: grows and shrinks with the game window (HUD scale 100%% is the original size at 1080p).
Minecraft GUI Scale: follows GUI Scale in steps, like vanilla menus.
Fixed pixels: the same size on screen whatever the window or GUI Scale.
skyblock-shopping-list.config.spacing.in: How far each ingredient level is pushed right.
skyblock-shopping-list.config.spacing.pa: Space between the panel edge and the rows.
Thickness of the panel border (0 = none).
Rounds the panel corners by this many pixels (0 = square).
skyblock-shopping-list.config.spacing.ro: Thickness of each row's coloured border (0 = none).
Height of each row. Rows shrink if the HUD runs out of room.
Rounds the corners of each row box by this many pixels (0 = square).
skyblock-shopping-list.config.spacing.ti: Space between a panel's title bar and its first row.
skyblock-shopping-list.config.text.bold_: Show the recipes on your list (top rows) in bold.
Fonts from Minecraft and your enabled resource packs. If a pack's font is removed, the HUD falls back to the default font.
skyblock-shopping-list.config.text.mob_d: Size of the Mob drops section.
skyblock-shopping-list.config.text.row_s: Size of the recipe rows. Rows stay left-aligned so the tree lines up.
skyblock-shopping-list.config.text.shado: Draw a shadow under HUD text.
skyblock-shopping-list.config.text.title: Title alignment
Title size
Size of the panel titles.
skyblock-shopping-list.config.tracking_c: Colours that show how far along each item is: amounts, row borders and item names.
skyblock-shopping-list.hud.title: Shopping List
skyblock-shopping-list.move_hud.hint: Drag to move (Shift: no snap), corner to scale, edge to resize
skyblock-shopping-list.picker.match.name: Name
skyblock-shopping-list.picker.match.tool:
Name: search item names.
Uses: search ingredients, e.g. coal finds Torch.
skyblock-shopping-list.picker.owned.tool:
Owned: items you have at least one of (inventory, sacks, storage).
Missing: items you have none of.
skyblock-shopping-list.picker.rarity.too: Rarity: Common to Divine, or Special.
skyblock-shopping-list.picker.type.toolt: Item type: Armor, Accessory, Pet, Weapon, Tool, Equipment or Other.
skyblock-shopping-list.reminder.stale.op: Open your sacks to refresh them.
skyblock-shopping-list.reminder.stale.ti: Sack counts may be out of date
skyblock-shopping-list.screen.list.add_m:
Add more (+): the amount is how many more to make on top of what you hold.
Click for Have total.
skyblock-shopping-list.screen.list.empty: Empty - click a recipe on the left to add it
skyblock-shopping-list.screen.list.have_:
Have total (=): the amount is how many you want in total; what you hold counts.
Click for Add more.
skyblock-shopping-list.screen.list.move_: Move down: lower rows get what is left.
Move up: higher rows get shared materials first.
skyblock-shopping-list.screen.list.picke: Click a recipe to add it
skyblock-shopping-list.screen.recipes.se: Select a recipe from the list
OFF: only items you have. ON: every tracked item, so you can set one you have none of.
skyblock-shopping-list.screen.saved.empt: Name the list and click Save
skyblock-shopping-list.screen.saved.load: Loaded "%s" without its last %s recipe(s): the list holds %s (Settings)
skyblock-shopping-list.screen.saved.name: List name
List name...
skyblock-shopping-list.screen.saved.past: Save a list from a share code on the clipboard. Your shopping list is not changed.
skyblock-shopping-list.screen.saved.save: Save the shopping list under this name. A saved list with the same name is replaced.
skyblock-shopping-list.toast.code_copied: Paste it anywhere to share your look.
skyblock-shopping-list.toast.no_code.mes: The clipboard doesn't hold a %s code.
skyblock-shopping-list.toast.no_list_cod: The clipboard doesn't hold a saved list code with known recipes.
skyblock-shopping-list.toast.preset_not_: The file couldn't be written; see the log.
skyblock-shopping-list.waiting: Waiting for your SkyBlock profile, try again in a moment
skyblock-shopping-list.welcome.intro: §eA shopping list for Hypixel SkyBlock: pick recipes, see what you still need.
skyblock-shopping-list.welcome.setup.ste: §e1. Press §b%s§e and click recipes to add them to your shopping list
§e2. Check or correct your counts in 'Your Resources'
§e3. Press §b%s§e to show the shopping list on screen
skyblock-shopping-list.welcome.setup.sto: ⚠️ Open your Backpacks and Ender Chest once so they are counted. The HUD tells you which Sacks to open. ⚠️
